purpose: Track canonical ownership, implementation evidence, and continuity for VX/VLNS integration without merging away historical lineage.

authority.rule: A repository README or architecture document is a claim source, not sufficient runtime proof.

repositories.name: VAIXLNS
repositories.role: Canonical architecture, governance, registry, recovery, and innovation hub
repositories.promotion_policy: Preserve historical records and lineage; do not infer that every indexed element is implemented.

repositories.name: VAIXLNS-unified
repositories.role: Executable integration surface for VX, VLNS, federation, evidence, and runtime adapters
repositories.promotion_policy: Promote a capability only with code, focused tests, reproducible CI evidence, and a declared scope.

repositories.name: VLNS activation bridge
repositories.role: Contract and evidence boundary for controlled VLNS-to-VX activation
repositories.promotion_policy: External endpoint, credentials, and live activation remain environment-dependent; a prepared envelope is not proof of successful dispatch.

repositories.name: NEXENT
repositories.role: Discovery, research, architecture search, and evolution proposals
repositories.promotion_policy: Proposals must pass VX admission, policy/authority, verification, and operational assurance before execution.

repositories.name: vaixlns-core
repositories.promotion_policy: Reconcile documentation claims against executable source and tests before claiming runtime integration.

repositories.name: vaixlns-csd-kernel
repositories.promotion_policy: Treat as a contract/compiler input until parser, validator, tests, and runtime wiring are evidenced.

repositories.name: VX50_COMPLETE_BUILD
repositories.role: Historical/incomplete VX build line and recovery source
repositories.promotion_policy: Recover with provenance; do not silently replace or overwrite canonical implementation.

repositories.name: VAIXLNS-Intent-to-Reality
repositories.promotion_policy: Keep as a future integration boundary until executable contract and tests are verified.

invariants: No historical record is deleted merely because it is duplicate-looking or superseded.
Every canonicalization or merge records source identity, target identity, rationale, and lineage.
Unknown or missing evidence blocks promotion; it is not treated as success.
OIF is operational assurance, not consensus.
Replay is evidence for reproducibility, not by itself proof of distributed replication.
A green unit test does not establish production readiness or full federation completeness.
External tools, MCP servers, models, and repositories remain untrusted until explicitly admitted.
Never store tokens, credentials, private keys, or secrets in this manifest.
known_open_gaps: Element-by-element recovery and reconciliation of the historical master index 0001-2750 is not yet proven complete.
Full GitHub-wide repository indexing and continuous change detection require configured, authenticated execution.
Live VLNS endpoint connectivity and credential configuration are external deployment responsibilities.
Distributed consensus, leader election, replication, and multi-node failover require separate implementation and reproducible tests.
Production deployment, observability collectors, and external service health are not proven by this static manifest.
